using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCritical_WhenGossipProcessingThrows()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>(); // Simplified mock
            var mockClient = new Mock<GarnetClient>();
            var configByteArray = new byte[0];
            var replicaId = "test-replica";
            var resp = new Mock<ArraySegment<byte>>();

            mockClient.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>())).ReturnsAsync(resp.Object);
            resp.Setup(r => r.Span.ToArray()).Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Setup FailoverSession with minimal dependencies to reach the target code path
            var session = new FailoverSessionTestFixture(mockLogger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object)
            {
                client = mockClient.Object,
                configByteArray = configByteArray,
                replicaId = replicaId,
                failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                cts = new CancellationTokenSource()
            };

            // Act
            await session.BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(replicaId, configByteArray);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogCritical(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAny<string>>((message, m) => m == "IssueAttachReplicas faulted"),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Minimal test fixture to enable testing the private method
    public class FailoverSessionTestFixture : FailoverSession
    {
        public FailoverSessionTestFixture(ILogger<FailoverSession> logger, IClusterProvider clusterProvider)
        {
            this.logger = logger;
            this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
            this.oldConfig = new ClusterConfig(); // Minimal config
            this.epoch = 1;
            this.failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
            this.cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        }

        public GarnetClient client;
        public byte[] configByteArray;
        public string replicaId;
        public TimeSpan failoverTimeout;
        public CancellationTokenSource cts;

        public new async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(string replicaId, byte[] configByteArray)
        {
            // Make accessible for testing and setup mocks
            this.client ??= new Mock<GarnetClient>().Object;
            await base.BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(replicaId, configByteArray);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCritical_WhenGossipProcessingThrows()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            var logger = mockLogger.Object;
            
            // Capture the LogCritical call
            mockLogger
                .Setup(x => x.LogCritical(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg == "IssueAttachReplicas faulted")))
                .Verifiable();

            // Create minimal mocks for dependencies
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<object>();
            var mockOldConfig = new Mock<ClusterConfig>();
            mockOldConfig.Setup(c => c.LocalNodePrimaryId).Returns("primary1");
            
            var mockClient = new Mock<GarnetClient>();
            var mockResp = new Mock<ArraySegment<byte>>();
            mockResp.Setup(r => r.Length).Returns(0);
            mockResp.Setup(r => r.Span.ToArray()).Throws(new InvalidOperationException("test exception"));

            mockClient.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>())).ReturnsAsync(mockResp.Object);

            // Test double to access private method via reflection
            var session = new FailoverSessionTestDouble(logger, mockClusterProvider.Object, mockOldConfig.Object)
            {
                primaryClient = mockClient.Object,
                failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1),
                cts = new CancellationTokenSource()
            };

            // Act
            await session.CallBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync("test-replica", new byte[0]);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogCritical(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    "IssueAttachReplicas faulted"),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test double that exposes private method via public wrapper
    public class FailoverSessionTestDouble
    {
        private readonly FailoverSession _session;

        public FailoverSessionTestDouble(
            ILogger<FailoverSession> logger,
            object clusterProvider,
            ClusterConfig oldConfig)
        {
            // Use reflection to set private fields since class is internal
            _session = Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(FailoverSession)) as FailoverSession 
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to create FailoverSession");
            
            typeof(FailoverSession).GetField("logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(_session, logger);
            typeof(FailoverSession).GetField("clusterProvider", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(_session, clusterProvider);
            typeof(FailoverSession).GetField("oldConfig", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(_session, oldConfig);
        }

        public GarnetClient primaryClient
        {
            set => typeof(FailoverSession).GetField("primaryClient", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(_session, value);
        }

        public TimeSpan failoverTimeout
        {
            set => typeof(FailoverSession).GetField("failoverTimeout", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(_session, value);
        }

        public CancellationTokenSource cts
        {
            set => typeof(FailoverSession).GetField("cts", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(_session, value);
        }

        public async Task CallBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(string replicaId, byte[] configByteArray)
        {
            var method = typeof(FailoverSession).GetMethod("BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync", 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            await (Task)method!.Invoke(_session, new object[] { replicaId, configByteArray })!;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCritical_WhenGossipProcessingThrows()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            
            // Create test data that triggers the exception path
            var configByteArray = new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 }; // Non-empty to pass resp.Length > 0
            var replicaId = "test-replica";
            
            // Create minimal fixture using public constructor and reflection for private fields
            var session = CreateTestSession(mockLogger.Object);
            
            // Setup conditions to reach the try-catch block around gossip processing
            // Set primaryClient to non-null and matching replicaId to skip GetConnectionAsync
            SetPrivateField(session, "primaryClient", new object()); 
            
            // Mock the gossip response to have Length > 0 and throw on ToArray()
            var mockResp = new Mock<IDisposable>(); // ArraySegment<byte> implements IDisposable
            mockResp.Setup(r => r.Length).Returns(10); // > 0
            // Simulate exception on resp.Span.ToArray() via a wrapper that throws
            var mockClient = new Mock<GarnetClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>())).ReturnsAsync(mockResp.Object);
            
            SetPrivateField(session, "primaryClient", mockClient.Object);

            // Act - use reflection to call private method
            await InvokePrivateMethod<Task>(session, "BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync", replicaId, configByteArray);

            // Assert - verify LogCritical was called with correct message
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogCritical(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    "IssueAttachReplicas faulted"),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private static FailoverSession CreateTestSession(ILogger<FailoverSession> logger)
        {
            var session = (FailoverSession)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(FailoverSession), 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance, 
                null, null, null)!;
            
            // Set required private fields via reflection
            SetPrivateField(session, "logger", logger);
            SetPrivateField(session, "failoverTimeout", TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
            SetPrivateField(session, "cts", new CancellationTokenSource());
            SetPrivateField(session, "oldConfig", new object()); // Minimal config
            SetPrivateField(session, "clusterProvider", new object()); // Minimal provider
            
            return session;
        }

        private static void SetPrivateField(FailoverSession session, string fieldName, object value)
        {
            var field = typeof(FailoverSession).GetField(fieldName, 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            field.SetValue(session, value);
        }

        private static T InvokePrivateMethod<T>(FailoverSession session, string methodName, params object[] args)
        {
            var method = typeof(FailoverSession).GetMethod(methodName, 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
            return (T)method.Invoke(session, args)!;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogCritical_VerifyLoggerExtension_CanBeCalled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            var logger = mockLogger.Object;
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act
            logger.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");

            // Assert - verify the underlying Log method was called with LogLevel.Critical
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((data, t) => t == "IssueAttachReplicas faulted"),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogCritical_WithNullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger<FailoverSession> logger = null;
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act & Assert
            logger?.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");
        }
    }
}
